ADDENDUM TO CONTRACT – Further Extra Special Conditions of Sale (VAT and Transfer of a Going Concern)  

This addendum forms part of and is incorporated into the Contract of Sale of the Lot and shall be read together with the General Conditions, the Special Conditions of Sale and Extra-special Conditions of Sale. The provisions of this addendum shall apply in addition to and where inconsistent, shall prevail over the General Conditions and any other Special Conditions or extra Conditions of Sale. Capitalised terms used but not defined in this Addendum shall have the meaning given to them in the Contract.

The following definitions shall apply go the Lot: 

'HMRC': means HM Revenue & Customs; 

'TOGC’: Transfer' means a transfer of a business as a going concern pursuant to section 49 of the VAT Act and article 5 of the Value Added Tax (Special Provisions) Order 1995; 

1.	The Seller is a Local Authority and is not in occupation of the Property for the purposes of any business carried on by it.

2.	The Seller and the Buyer intend that the sale of the Lot shall constitute a transfer of a going concern (TOGC Transfer) for the purposes of Schedule 10 of the Value Added Tax 1994, on the basis that the Lot is sold subject to the occupational leases referred to in the Legal Pack and that the Buyer intends to continue the property letting business carried on by the Seller and provided that the Buyer can meet the conditions in G15.4. 

3.	The Lot has been used to carry on a property letting business and that the VAT Option made by it in respect of the Lot, has not been revoked entirely or in relation to the Property. 

4.	The Seller gives no warranty or representation that the transfer will qualify as a transfer of a going concern and shall have no liability to the Buyer if HMRC determines that VAT is chargeable on the sale or transaction.

5.	The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that:
(a)	The Lot is sold subject to the leases of the ground floor units currently occupied as a pharmacy and a hairdressing salon, particulars of which are contained in the Legal pack;
(b)	The first-floor accommodation is vacant and produces no income.

6.	The Buyer confirms that the existence of vacant accommodation within the Property shall not prevent the transfer of the Lot being treated as a transfer of a going concern and that the Buyer has satisfied itself in this regard.

7.	The Buyer warrants and undertakes to the Seller that: 
a)	the Buyer is and will be at the date of Completion registered for VAT (and the Buyer shall give to the Seller evidence satisfactory to the Seller that the Buyer is registered for VAT prior to Completion); 

b)	in respect of the Lot, the Buyer has, prior to the Agreed Completion Date made a valid VAT Option and has notified HMRC of its VAT Option (and the Buyer shall give to the Seller evidence satisfactory to the Seller of these matters prior to Completion); 

c)	it will not revoke its VAT Option in respect of the Lot within three months of Completion; 

d)	article 5(2B) of the Value Added Tax (Special Provisions) Order 1995 does not apply to the Buyer; 

e)	the Lot is to be the used by the Buyer from the date of Completion in carrying on the same kind of business, being a property letting business, as that carried on by the Seller prior to the date of Completion;

f)	the Buyer shall not in the six-month period after the date of Completion occupy the Lot itself; 

g)	 the Buyer will itself hold the legal and beneficial ownership of the Lot for itself; and

h)	the Buyer shall not do or omit to do anything prior to or following Completion which would or might cause the transfer of the Lot to fail to qualify as a transfer of a going concern.

8.	The Buyer acknowledges that the Seller shall not be responsible for ensuring that the Buyer’s option to tax is valid or effective.

9.	If, at any point after Completion HMRC notifies (including, without limitation, by way of assessment) the Seller that the sale of the LOT is not a TOGC Transfer, the Buyer will pay to the Seller any VAT payable in respect of the sale of the Lot within five Business Days of receipt by it of a valid VAT invoice from the Seller. 

10.	If the sale of the Lot is treated as a TOGC Transfer and at any point after Completion HMRC notifies (including without limitation, by way of assessment) the Seller that the sale of the Lot is not a TOGC Transfer, the Buyer will indemnify and keep indemnified the Seller against any interest and penalties  charged or imposed by HMRC on the Seller as a result of or in connection with any failure by the Seller to account for VAT or any late payment of VAT, if the sale of the Lot is not a TOGC Transfer because of a breach by the Buyer of any of the warranties in Condition G15.4. The Buyer shall (in addition) indemnify and keep indemnified the Seller against all costs and expenses incurred by or demanded of the Seller arising out of or in connection with any such notification or determination.

11.	The Buyer shall not be entitled to withhold, set off or delay payment of any VAT due under these conditions, or entitled to rescind the Contract, delay Completion or make any objection, requisition or claim against the Seller by reason of:

(a)	any uncertainty as to whether the sale qualifies as a transfer of a going concern; or
(b)	any determination by HMRC that VAT is chargeable on the transaction.


12.	The provisions of these Special Conditions relating to VAT and transfer of a going concern: 
(a)	survive Completion of the sale; and
(b)	in case of a conflict, override the VAT provisions in the Standard Conditions of Sale.


The successful buyer will be required to pay the Auctioneers a total buyers fee of £3,500 plus VAT upon exchange of sale memoranda. Therefore the total buyers fee payable inclusive of VAT will be £4,200.

G24. TENANCY RENEWALS

G24.1 This CONDITION G24 applies where the tenant under a TENANCY has the right to remain in occupation under part II of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 (as amended) and references to notices and proceedings are to notices and proceedings under that Act.

G24.2 Where practicable, without exposing the SELLER to liability or penalty, The SELLER must not without the written consent of the BUYER (which the BUYER must not unreasonably withhold or delay) serve or respond to any notice or begin or continue any proceedings. 

G24.3 If the SELLER receives a notice the SELLER must send a copy to the BUYER within five BUSINESS DAYS and act as the BUYER reasonably directs in relation to it. 

G24.4 Following COMPLETION the BUYER must: 

(a) with the co-operation of the SELLER take immediate steps to substitute itself as a party to any proceedings; 
(b) use all reasonable endeavours to conclude any proceedings or negotiations for the renewal of the TENANCY and the determination of any interim rent as soon as reasonably practicable at the best rent or rents reasonably obtainable; and 
(c) if any increased rent is recovered from the tenant (whether as interim rent or under the renewed TENANCY) account to the SELLER for the part of that increase that relates to the SELLER’s period of ownership of the LOT within five BUSINESS DAYS of receipt of cleared funds. 

G24.5 The SELLER and the BUYER are to bear their own costs in relation to the renewal of the TENANCY and any proceedings relating to this.
